PROC
PROC_ApplySavegamePatches()
AND
QRY_BG3_SavegameIsOlderThan("Release Patch 6")
AND
DB_DismissedAvatar(_DismissedAvatar)
AND
IsInInventoryOf(S_GLO_PuzzleBox_326324f9-0920-8f0f-3e85-3781fbf48282, _DismissedAvatar, 1)
THEN
DB_BUGFIX_Marker("GUS-309655_Avatar");
PROC_GLO_InfernalBox_SendToAvatarFrom(_DismissedAvatar);

PROC
PROC_DebugBook_Event("SH_ORI_ACT2_NightOrchid", _)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
_Player != S_Player_ShadowHeart_3ed74f06-3c60-42dc-83f6-f034cb47c679
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("ORI_Shadowheart_Debug_AddedOrchid")
THEN
PROC_GlobalSetFlagAndCache((FLAG)ORI_Shadowheart_Knows_PersonalInfo_abbc836e-07f0-4951-bb7b-beac52d91b2a);
TemplateAddTo((ITEMROOT)QUEST_SCL_NightOrchid_11f6de17-4682-419c-808f-8a328d2cce15, _Player, 1, 1);
